1084-4279-6559.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
1084-4279-6559.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Venerated Stormsinger triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
1084-4279-6559.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

222-527-5256-8296.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-5256-8296.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

856-4321-6351-8249.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-4321-6351-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Teval trigger.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

2790-4836-4989.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is equal to or greater than 55 minus 4 for each opponent you have.
2790-4836-4989.notablePrerequisites: Opponents cannot block creatures you control.
2790-4836-4989.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Duke Ulder Ravengard triggers, giving Angel of Destiny haste and myriad until end of turn.
Declare Angel of Destiny as an attacker. Its myriad ability triggers, creating a tapped and attacking copy of Angel of Destiny attacking each other opponent.
Deal combat damage with Angel of Destiny, causing each Angel of Destiny to trigger, causing you to gain 4 life for each Angel of Destiny and causing each opponent to gain 4 life.
Move to your end step. The Angel of Destiny tokens won't be exiled due to The Master.
At the beginning of your end step, each Angel of Destiny triggers, causing each opponent they dealt combat damage to to lose the game.

141-1893-4247.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1893-4247.description:
Cast Shallow Grave by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Shallow Grave.
Holding priority, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Naru Meha, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Shallow Grave
Resolve the Shallow Grave copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

206-3490-5477-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature token that has not been tapped this turn.
206-3490-5477-7075.description:
Activate a creature token by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1170-2146-5131-6495--202.easyPrerequisites:
Cloud Key has "Artifact" chosen.
You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2146-5131-6495--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Cloud Key.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat.
1170-2146-5131-6495--202.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

4247-7940--5.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Support Mission triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat

1981-2415-4247-6772.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Syr Vondam and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

3899-5170-6132-6794.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Susurian Voidborn trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

1308-4559-5147-7839.easyPrerequisites: The total mana value of noncreature artifacts you control is 11 or greater.
1308-4559-5147-7839.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating two artifact tokens due to Anointed Procession.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the two artifact tokens, returning Metalwork Colossus from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2724-4006-5775.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fortune.
2724-4006-5775.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Fortune. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Hushbringer.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

4365-6252-7282.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating two token copies of Boommobile.
When the Boommobile tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, adding {8} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
4365-6252-7282.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate a Boommobile to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

1115-5921-5970-7014.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of North Pole Patrol.
Activate one of the North Pole Patrol tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other North Pole Patrol token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

1976-4771-5660.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it, targeting Evolution Witness, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Myr Scrapling from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Scrapling by paying {0}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

2438-3773-6972--112.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Cultivator of Blades.
When Cultivator of Blades dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Cultivator of Blades enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.
2438-3773-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Cultivator of Blades's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

671-1497-5220-6900.description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Mortuary and Daxos trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Wild Cantor from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Daxos trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Cast Wild Cantor from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Wild Cantor enters, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2866-4708-4986-5231.description:
Cast Dark Sphere by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Dark Sphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1447-1734-3967.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying {1}{W}{W}.
When Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Angel of Glory's Rise.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Angel of Glory's Rise from exile to the battlefield.
When Angel of Glory's Rise enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

618-1734-3967.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Fiend Hunter.
When the Fiend Hunter token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the Fiend Hunter token.
When the Fiend Hunter token dies, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

3388-3949-5745.manaNeeded: {2}{G}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
3388-3949-5745.description:
Cast Moritte of the Frost from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{G}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Staff of Eden.
Put Moritte of the Frost into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Morrite of the Frost's enters-the-battlefield ability and Kappa Cannoneer trigger.
Resolve the Kappa Cannoneer trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing it to be unblockable this turn.
Resolve the Moritte of the Frost trigger, returning Moritte of the Frost from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Staff of Eden.
Repeat from step 2.

1309-1987-2510.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.You control an artifact or land that enters the battlefield untapped and can produce {U}.
1309-1987-2510.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Salvager of Secrets and your untapped source, blinking them both.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to your hand.
Tap your untapped blue source for {U}.
Repeat.

2034-4640.notablePrerequisites: You conrtol a nontoken Samurai and/or a nontoken creature with changeling.
2034-4640.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Samurai or changeling, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Oathkeeper triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Oathkeeper's equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to the creature.
Repeat.
